# Fixtures

Regenerated by `generate.py` (command in its docstring), including `rotated.pdf` (one rotated page with NORTH in unrotated coordinates) and `blank.pdf` (one empty page), except:

| File | Source |
|---|---|
| `sample.msg` | Verbatim copy of [`example-msg-files/unicode.msg`](https://github.com/TeamMsgExtractor/msg-extractor/blob/73e4d1b484e2daf82c1aa587f13c59702ec684a4/example-msg-files/unicode.msg) from https://github.com/TeamMsgExtractor/msg-extractor, upstream commit `73e4d1b484e2daf82c1aa587f13c59702ec684a4` ("Added unicode example"), GPL-3.0. Fetched 2026-09-30; test artifact only, not in the npm tarball. From `Brian Zhou`, HTML body, two `.tif` attachments. |
| `sample.doc` | `soffice --convert-to doc` of `headings.docx`; regenerated only when soffice is on PATH |
| `pre-ocr.pdf` | `generate.py pre_ocr_pdf`; regenerated only when `tesseract` is on PATH (bakes an OCR text layer into scan.pdf page 1) |
